title: Preserve fingerprint read failure diagnostics when descriptor close also fails
outcome: Preserve the primary fingerprint failure information alongside a bounded secondary close failure while retaining fail-closed behavior.
acceptance: Primary read/hash failure and a secondary close failure remain distinguishable in bounded diagnostics, with no successful result returned after either failure.

Deterministic regressions cover close-only and simultaneous primary-plus-close failures without weakening source-change detection; required independent review and full-gate evidence are recorded for the final change.
